scope: Spline electron v_z loose, 3D Bayesian only, on a copy of fits/spline/dcv_el/loose/fit_copy.root. Q2-y 1-17, 452 histograms. RC_Bayesian, BC_RC_Bayesian, Bin, and 5D are absent and were not created. No publication. The source ROOT file, budgets, sector exclusions, histogram weights, and the shared Phi_h guides were not edited. The destination did not already contain refinement_note.json and fit.json, so this is not a resume.
start_mode: manual. start=auto: the 3D spline B windows for these 452 histograms have median width 0.0153 and 428 are narrower than 0.05, and the C median width is 0.0070 with 445 narrower than 0.05, so those windows can pin a fit. The run-local guide started as Phi_h_Fit_Parameters_Initialize.py. --use_spline_init was not passed.
changed: Pass 1 refit all 452 histograms with the manual baseline and the corrected filled-window range. It improved 7 and made 25 worse, because the manual B and C windows exclude this histogram's cosine and the second pass then stops halfway. (Q2_y_Bin_1)-(z_pT_Bin_8) only moved from the pinned B=-0.045000, statistical error 0.019561, C=0.004982, error 0.009584, chi-squared 47.328, NDF 13, to B=-0.065217 with C collapsed near 0 and chi-squared 45.760. That is still short of this histogram's cosine. Pass 2 put 50 starts on each histogram's own unconstrained cosine, opened only the limits that excluded that cosine, and turned off the second-pass half-width window when |B| or |C| was below 0.05. It refit Q2-y 1-16. Q2-y 17 was not refit again; its histograms already matched the cosine after pass 1. JSON still has 452 bins. Unselected Q2-y bins were not dropped. 30 histograms have a lower chi-squared than the stored fit and none is higher by more than 0.0022, on (Q2_y_Bin_7)-(z_pT_Bin_4). Meaningful drops: (Q2_y_Bin_1)-(z_pT_Bin_17) 41.515 to 31.332; (Q2_y_Bin_1)-(z_pT_Bin_4) 66.044 to 56.340; (Q2_y_Bin_6)-(z_pT_Bin_2) 75.603 to 65.935; (Q2_y_Bin_16)-(z_pT_Bin_16) 46.131 to 39.075; (Q2_y_Bin_15)-(z_pT_Bin_24) 49.713 to 42.821; (Q2_y_Bin_1)-(z_pT_Bin_22) 26.047 to 19.253; (Q2_y_Bin_7)-(z_pT_Bin_11) 37.910 to 31.769; (Q2_y_Bin_1)-(z_pT_Bin_8) 47.328 to 42.492. (Q2_y_Bin_1)-(z_pT_Bin_8) is kept at B=-0.120958, statistical error 0.034224, C=-0.038833, error 0.031518, chi-squared 42.492, NDF 13, status completed, phi 60-300, 16 histogram bins inside the TF1 range. That is this histogram's cosine, not the nominal B=-0.125184. The nominal-minus-variation B shift is now +0.004225 instead of the pinned +0.080184. Stored ranges already matched the filled window, and the refit kept that match: 0 mismatches.
left_bins: No 5D family is in this file, so nothing was left from a 3D-versus-5D disagreement. Large nominal-minus-variation shifts that already match this histogram were not moved: (Q2_y_Bin_5)-(z_pT_Bin_3) B=-0.196055 versus nominal -0.154434, chi-squared unchanged. (Q2_y_Bin_3)-(z_pT_Bin_3) moved to its own cosine B=-0.173754, which is farther from the nominal -0.138678, because the points support that value. (Q2_y_Bin_4)-(z_pT_Bin_29), (Q2_y_Bin_2)-(z_pT_Bin_14), and (Q2_y_Bin_7)-(z_pT_Bin_35) likewise keep the cosine rather than the nominal. Four bins still have a cos(2phi) or cos(phi) error that collapses because the amplitude is consistent with zero: (Q2_y_Bin_4)-(z_pT_Bin_32), (Q2_y_Bin_8)-(z_pT_Bin_21), (Q2_y_Bin_14)-(z_pT_Bin_10), and (Q2_y_Bin_16)-(z_pT_Bin_3). The free cosine does not change those shapes, so the limits were not opened. The collapsed errors are a stability note, not a smaller systematic uncertainty, and they are not added to the systematic budget. Excluded sector pairs were not put back into this comparison. Missing comparisons stay missing, not zero. The electron v_z source was not removed.

why_retained: The final pass is kept because every histogram chi-squared is at least as low as the stored fit, aside from a 0.002 numerical change, 30 are lower, and the curves follow each histogram's own cosine. (Q2_y_Bin_1)-(z_pT_Bin_8) is no longer pinned at B=-0.045. The nominal value was not imposed. The overlay in overlays/loose_final.png shows the retained curve on the points and the stored curve. Fit-parameter errors were not added to the systematic uncertainty.
